payload.name: pc-contrast-07
payload.description: Pure-logic guard: validate a raw list of 1..3 records, each with exactly code (string length 2..5) and enabled (exact bool), and return {ok, records} echoing the original list only when valid. No I/O, imports, host calls or upstream validation assumption. Empty, missing, null, wrong-type, extra-field or out-of-range inputs yield {ok: false, records: []} without exceptions or coercion.
